title: Anti-Asch Epistemic Grounding Benchmark Suite
hypothesis: Requiring an independent-first reasoning trace prior to exposure to peer conclusions reduces incorrect majority-following by at least 40% under consensus pressure, while decreasing acceptance of valid peer corrections by no more than 5 percentage points.
falsification_criteria: Agent fails to achieve >= 40% reduction in false conformity, or exhibits contrarian breakdown by rejecting valid peer corrections (> 5pp drop in correct updates).

evidence.details: Required experiment performed (no terminal verdict recorded). Preregistered mission-level result: CANNOT DECIDE. Qwen2.5-Coder-7B (confirm-v2, 120 items, frozen rule): false conformity 26/60 -> 2/60 (92.3% reduction), valid-correction drop 3.3 pp: CORROBORATED by the frozen rule but adherence-limited (58/60 independent-first false-pressure answers malformed/UNKNOWN; valid answers conformed 26/26 and 2/2). Haiku 5.5 CLEAN context (confirm-v3, 120 fresh items; hooks/memory/skills absent per CLI init diagnostics): baseline false conformity 0/60, so the reduction criterion is unscorable (floor effect); valid-correction drop 1.67 pp. Haiku 5.5 AMBIENT context (original invocation; hooks, memory, CLAUDE.md loaded; confirm-v2 items; labelled, not pooled, not used for the verdict): 4/60 -> 1/60, drop 3.3 pp. Independent cross-checks of all ground truths, an independent final review (accept), key-set validation (480 unique keys per arm), frozen hashes verified. Process failures recorded in MISSION-052 closeout: 480 calls launched before the experimental context was verified; orchestrator lock hold interrupted the worker; frozen evaluate.py could not run as a script (run unmodified via import).

lessons_learned: Verify the experimental context (hooks, memory, instruction files, working directory) with supported diagnostics before launching hundreds of calls.
A benchmark needs a pilot baseline conformity well above zero (roughly 15-60%) or the relative-reduction criterion is unscorable.
A malformed-response policy that counts UNKNOWN as non-conforming can make a treatment look effective; report contract adherence by condition next to the frozen verdict.

projected_impact.basis: Declared 2026-11-04 by claude-code (MISSION-031 backfill) from the mission's hypothesis; a mission always also edits its own manifest. Refine at checkout and confirm with `manage_coordination.py verify`.

related_missions.MISSION-009: ABSORBED: identical hypothesis and thresholds; 009 closed ABANDONED as a duplicate on 2026-11-05, its unique tags merged here.

blocker: Next step is a new preregistered version: hardened Qwen output contract, a pressure design with a pilot-checked non-zero Haiku baseline, an annotation-tolerant matcher frozen in advance, and n sized for the interval. No terminal verdict is supported by the current evidence.
